Comparison with a competitor: 'Brex didn't successfully make the AI pivot like their competitors at Ramp.'
After looking at Brex's 'AI-enabled' products, a commenter said they looked 'more like pure gimmickry.' They added that Brex makes its money elsewhere, so it can afford to experiment.

A commenter noted Brex isn't a bank but has a checking-account-like business account. They listed its AI uses as fraud/risk/underwriting, auto-generated receipts and data enrichment, and AI assistants for all users.
Praise: 'I really liked the dynamic credit card generator, and Brex Travel was luxurious.' The same user asked what alternatives people were moving to after Brex dropped small business customers.

'We're a startup on Brex. Not sure if we're about to get the boot.'
